goal: The VM watcher operates with Ops-owned thresholds and the Claude watcher session retires once it is proven.
acceptance: thresholds file owned by Ops with the default values
for 24 h the VM watcher and the Claude watcher run side by side; every Claude alarm is also raised by the VM watcher
then the Claude watcher and its routine are retired (baseline archives them)
the session snapshot keeps being published at least hourly; a gap raises the stale alarm
